title: [Open to all] Share a tip about a scam you've seen recently
what: Think of a scam you, a friend or a family member came across recently: a fake giveaway, a "you've won" message, a crypto "double your money" offer, a fake delivery text. Turn it into one short tip that helps others spot it.
done: One new line in [`awareness/tips.md`](https://github.com/CyberSecTober/Cybersectober/blob/main/awareness/tips.md) in the usual format: `- **Short tip title**, one sentence explaining it. (@your-github-username)`. No real names, phone numbers or links to the scam.

title: [Open to all] Translate a security tip into your language (any language)
what: Pick any tip from [`awareness/tips.md`](https://github.com/CyberSecTober/Cybersectober/blob/main/awareness/tips.md) and translate it into your language. Every language is welcome, not just Yoruba, Igbo, Hausa, Pidgin and Swahili.
done: One translated tip added to `community/translations/your-language/tips.md` ([translations folder](https://github.com/CyberSecTober/Cybersectober/tree/main/community/translations)). Create the folder and file if they don't exist yet. Keep the original tip's meaning and credit yourself at the end of the line.

title: [Open to all] Write a 3-question security quiz
what: Write a short, fun multiple-choice quiz that helps people test what they know about phishing, passwords, scams or any security topic.
done: A new file in [`awareness/quizzes/`](https://github.com/CyberSecTober/Cybersectober/tree/main/awareness/quizzes) following the instructions in its README: 3 to 5 questions, multiple-choice answers, and an answers section that explains each one.

title: [Open to all] Write a short fictional scam story with a lesson
what: Write a short fictional story (150 to 400 words) about someone who almost falls for a scam, then list the red flags and the lesson. Stories are memorable and easy to share.
done: A new file in [`awareness/stories/`](https://github.com/CyberSecTober/Cybersectober/tree/main/awareness/stories) following the instructions in its README. Everyone and every company in it must be fictional, and any web address must use `example.com`.

title: [Open to all] Share your #CyberSecTOBER post
what: Post one security tip on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Threads or Medium with #CyberSecTOBER, then add the link to the project. Each post counts towards the awareness badges.
done: One new line in [`awareness/posts.md`](https://github.com/CyberSecTober/Cybersectober/blob/main/awareness/posts.md): `- [Short description](https://link-to-your-post) (@your-github-username)`. The post must be public and your own.

title: [Open to all] Bust a security myth in a social post

done: One new line in [`awareness/posts.md`](https://github.com/CyberSecTober/Cybersectober/blob/main/awareness/posts.md) linking to your post: `- [Short description](https://link-to-your-post) (@your-github-username)`.
